meta.scope: Philippines Batch 11 — MSME structure, gender statistics, and additional structural densification.

candidates.title: MSME establishment and structure statistics
candidates.description: Official counts and structure of micro, small and medium enterprises. MSMEs constitute the overwhelming majority of registered establishments (recently >99 %) and a large share of employment.
candidates.notes: Core enterprise-structure node. Complements the formal manufacturing (ASPBI) and IT-BPM series.

candidates.title: MSME development and financing policy framing
candidates.description: Policy and programme framing around MSME support, credit guarantees, financing access and entrepreneurship promotion.
candidates.notes: Policy-frame counterpart to the MSME statistical node.

candidates.title: Women and Men in the Philippines / Core GAD indicators
candidates.description: Official gender statistics and Philippine Core Gender and Development (GAD) indicators covering population, education, health, labour, political participation and related domains.
referenced_by: Labour Force Survey and OFW gender composition

candidates.title: Housing and household characteristics statistics
candidates.description: Housing stock, tenure, access to basic services and related household characteristics drawn from census and household surveys. Links to construction, urbanisation and welfare analysis.
candidates.notes: Housing densification of the social and construction clusters.

candidates.title: Philippines MSME–gender–housing densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA, DTI and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding MSME establishment and policy framing, Women and Men / GAD indicators, and housing/household characteristics into a coherent enterprise–gender–housing layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier labour, digital, construction and social series
